summary: Identiv, Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose a supplement to its June 24, 2026 Governance Letter Agreement with Bleichroeder LP, clarifying that the proportional voting requirement triggers whenever Bleichroeder owns over 40% of voting stock, regardless of cause (purchases, conversion of Series B Preferred, or company repurchases). This is a governance clarification, not a special-situation corporate event. No deal terms, prices, or strategic actions are involved. Routine current report; no special-situation category applies.
